## fig4_accuracy_vs_compute

Round-0 seconds per response = 11946.3 / 2000 = 5.9731 s (generation and readouts of the pool's answers; not separable in the records). Independent k: k × that. ## fig7_revision_gate (exploratory)

Pooled over all 1016 panels (422 questions; Gemma-3-12B datasets except main250 test), simulated with the gate deciding every changed answer, out-of-fold. 95% question-grouped bootstrap.

Gate AUROC (helpful vs harmful, out-of-fold): logistic 0.707 [0.618, 0.794], boosted tree 0.727 [0.659, 0.795].

Accept-all panel accuracy: 0.616 [0.568, 0.665].

| policy | panel accuracy | gain over accept-all |
|---|---|---|
| Reject every revision | 0.622 [0.572, 0.673] | 0.006 [-0.019, 0.031] |
| (a) Peer-majority rule | 0.623 [0.573, 0.673] | 0.007 [-0.016, 0.029] |
| (b) Conviction rule | 0.623 [0.572, 0.674] | 0.006 [-0.015, 0.027] |
